title: First Connections Checkpoint
concept: A1 greetings, identity, time, family, preferences, and ordering

questions.prompt: You meet someone for the first time. Which opening fits the situation?
questions.explanation: はじめまして is the conventional opening when meeting someone for the first time.

options.label: はじめまして。アナです。
おやすみなさい。アナです。
いただきます。アナです。

questions.prompt: Complete: I am also a student.
questions.explanation: も replaces は when the new topic shares the same description.

questions.prompt: A book is beside the listener. Ask whose book it is.
questions.explanation: それ points to something near the listener, and だれの asks whose.

options.label: それはだれのほんですか。
あのひとはなんですか。

questions.prompt: Someone says くじはんです. Which time did you hear?
questions.explanation: くじ is nine o'clock and はん adds half past.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to request one coffee politely.
questions.explanation: A simple order is item, quantity, then おねがいします.

questions.prompt: Which is a complete polite self-introduction model you can personalize?
questions.explanation: The model gives a name and one identity fact with です.

options.label: わたしはリーです。がくせいです。
